output.reason: The evidence supports the second part of the claim: it states that the RBI “Pre-payment Charges on Loans” Directions, 2025 were withdrawn/repealed effective 2025-11-28, and therefore are not in force as of 2026-11-23. However, the evidence does not address (or refute) any RBI requirement that UCBs charge “at least 2%” on pre-payment of loans to MSE; it only provides that a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on certain floating-rate loans up to ₹50 lakh. Therefore, the “not supported” portion regarding the 2% premise is not fully supported by the evidence alone.
